rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING BENEFITS FOR EARLY RETIREMENT AND VOLUNTARY SEPARATION FROM THE GOVERNMENT SERVICE, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Covers all appointive officials and employees of the national government, including government-owne d or-controlled corporations. as well as the personnel of all local government units. Applies to all REGULAR AND TEMPORARY EMPLOYEES appointed to permanent itemized positions, REGARDLESS OF AGE, who have RENDERED AT LEAST A TOTAL OF THREE (3) CONSECUTIVE YEARS of government service as of the date of separation.
rows.status: Substituted by HB03299

rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A UNIVERSAL, COMPREHENSIVE AND UNIFORM SOCIAL SECURITY AND INSURANCE PROGRAM FOR ALL GOVERNMENT EMPLOYEES, AND FOR THIS PURPOSE INTEGRATING, RATIONALIZING, CONSOLIDATING, REVISING, FURTHER INCREASING AND EXPANDING THE BENEFITS UNDER EXISTING LAWS BEING ADMINISTERED BY THE GOVERNMENT SERVICE INSURANCE SYSTEM, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Liberalizes the scope of social insurance and streamlines the procedures for availment of benefits, such as: (1) extension of coverage to all government workers, inlcuding temporary employees; (2) simplified adminsitrative operations and requirements; and (3) expansion of existing benefits.
rows.status: Substituted by HB08561

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR RENDITION OF COMMUNITY SERVICE IN LIEU OF DETENTION TO SERVE SENTENCE, CREATING FOR THE PURPOSE COMMUNITY WORK CAMPS, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: States that prisoners who have a remaining six (6) months or less to serve sentence shall CONTINUE TO SERVE THE SAME BY RENDERING COMMUNITY SERVICE, subject to the discretion of the Secretary of Justice in consultation with the Bureau of Prisons.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 1995-07-26
